name: Befora – Before After Gallery for Elementor
author: atiq29

sections.description:
Befora – Before After Gallery for Elementor adds a dedicated Elementor widget for interactive before and after image comparison galleries.

Create service or project categories and add multiple Before/After image pairs. Projects sharing the same category are grouped under one filter button automatically.

Features

  • Filterable before after gallery for Elementor
  • Unlimited project categories and comparison items
  • Fixed Before and After images with draggable reveal
  • Responsive columns, image height, row gap and column gap
  • Responsive widget, gallery, tabs, button padding and margins
  • Normal, Hover and Active filter button colors
  • Filter button typography, borders, radius and hover effects
  • Divider line color and width controls
  • Handle size, border, radius, Normal and Hover colors
  • Before and After label controls and styling
  • Image fit, position, border, radius and box shadow
  • Touch, mouse, pointer and keyboard support
  • Optional All tab and Before/After labels
  • Lazy-loaded images
  • Translation ready
  • Multiple widgets supported on the same page

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. Upload this plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor.
  5. Search for “Before After Gallery”.
  6. Add projects, categories, Before images and After images.
  7. Customize the widget from the Content and Style tabs.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

No. Elementor Pro is not required.

Can one category contain multiple comparisons?

Yes. Give multiple projects the same category name.

Do the images zoom while dragging?

No. Both images remain fixed. Only the clipped reveal area changes.

Is it responsive?

Yes. Columns, heights, gaps, margins, padding and several visual controls have desktop, tablet and mobile settings.

Can I use buttons on desktop and a dropdown on mobile?

Yes. Desktop, tablet, and mobile each have an independent filter navigation setting. Choose Buttons, Dropdown, or Both for each device.

  • Added mouse, touch, pointer, and keyboard interaction support.
